color-brand-moss.$description: Identity hue Moss, fixed in both themes. For the mark, imagery and print only; never an interface role. Ink of `assets/marks/stalpul-cerului-moss.svg`.

color-brand-lichen.$description: Identity hue Lichen, fixed in both themes. For the mark, imagery and print only; never an interface role. Ink of `assets/marks/stalpul-cerului-lichen.svg`, and the ground behind the moss mark in avatars.

color-brand-sage.$description: Identity hue Sage, fixed in both themes. For the mark, imagery and print only; never an interface role.

color-brand-peach.$description: Identity hue Peach, fixed in both themes. For the mark, imagery and print only; never an interface role.

color-brand-ember.$description: Identity hue Ember, fixed in both themes. For the mark, imagery and print only; never an interface role.

color-surface-default.$description: The page. Every text role from `ab-color-text-default` to `-danger` reads on it: lowest 5.48 light, 5.22 dark.

color-surface-raised.$description: One step from the page. Every text role from `ab-color-text-default` to `-danger` reads on it: lowest 4.98 light, 4.93 dark.

color-surface-nested.$description: A panel inside a raised panel. Every text role from `ab-color-text-default` to `-danger` reads on it: lowest 4.56 light, 4.58 dark.

color-surface-overlay.$description: Menus, popovers and dialogs. Every text role from `ab-color-text-default` to `-danger` reads on it: lowest 5.48 light, 4.93 dark.

color-background-neutral-subtle-hovered.$description: Hover fill of quiet controls, rows and menu items (the rest state is transparent).

color-background-neutral-subtle-pressed.$description: Pressed fill of quiet controls, rows and menu items.

color-background-selected.$description: Fill of the current item in a set.

color-background-accent-bold.$description: The single brand action fill (primary button, checked controls). Text on it is `ab-color-text-on-accent` (13.40 light, 10.96 dark).

color-background-accent-subtle.$description: Subtle accent fill; text roles read on it.

color-background-success-bold.$description: Filled success state. Text on it is `ab-color-text-on-success` (7.74 light, 10.85 dark).

color-background-success-subtle.$description: Tinted success fill (tags, toasts). Text on it is `ab-color-text-success` (7.27 light, 10.51 dark).

color-background-warning-bold.$description: Filled warning state. Text on it is `ab-color-text-on-warning` (8.00 light, 11.06 dark).

color-background-warning-subtle.$description: Tinted warning fill (tags, toasts). Text on it is `ab-color-text-warning` (8.58 light, 10.91 dark).

color-background-danger-bold.$description: Filled danger state (danger button). Text on it is `ab-color-text-on-danger` (5.76 light, 8.23 dark).

color-background-danger-subtle.$description: Tinted danger fill (tags, toasts). Text on it is `ab-color-text-danger` (5.34 light, 8.20 dark).

color-background-neutral-bold.$description: Inverse fill for tooltips; content on it uses `ab-color-text-inverse`. Text on it is `ab-color-text-inverse` (13.98 light, 15.93 dark).

color-background-highlight.$description: Behind one marked phrase per page. Text on it is `ab-color-text-on-highlight` (13.22 light, 13.22 dark).

color-background-disabled.$description: Fill of an unavailable control (exempt from contrast).

color-backdrop.$description: The dimming layer behind a modal (Dialog, Sheet, Command).

color-text-default.$description: Primary copy and headings, on `ab-color-surface-default`, `-raised`, `-nested`, `ab-color-background-selected` and `ab-color-background-accent-subtle`: lowest 14.75 light, 13.98 dark (needs 4.5:1).

color-text-subtle.$description: Secondary text, on `ab-color-surface-default`, `-raised`, `-nested`, `ab-color-background-selected` and `ab-color-background-accent-subtle`: lowest 6.14 light, 6.53 dark (needs 4.5:1).

color-text-subtlest.$description: Lowest-contrast text that still passes AA (helper text, hints), on `ab-color-surface-default`, `-raised`, `-nested`, `ab-color-background-selected` and `ab-color-background-accent-subtle`: lowest 4.56 light, 4.58 dark (needs 4.5:1).

color-text-accent.$description: Accent text and links, on `ab-color-surface-default`, `-raised`, `-nested`, `ab-color-background-selected` and `ab-color-background-accent-subtle`: lowest 11.16 light, 13.23 dark (needs 4.5:1).

color-text-selected.$description: The current item in a set, on `ab-color-surface-default`, `-raised`, `-nested`, `ab-color-background-selected` and `ab-color-background-accent-subtle`: lowest 11.16 light, 13.23 dark (needs 4.5:1).

color-text-success.$description: Success state, on `ab-color-surface-default`, `-raised`, `-nested`, `ab-color-background-selected` and `ab-color-background-accent-subtle`: lowest 6.44 light, 9.52 dark (needs 4.5:1).

color-text-warning.$description: Warning state, on `ab-color-surface-default`, `-raised`, `-nested`, `ab-color-background-selected` and `ab-color-background-accent-subtle`: lowest 7.70 light, 9.70 dark (needs 4.5:1).

color-text-danger.$description: Danger state and errors, on `ab-color-surface-default`, `-raised`, `-nested`, `ab-color-background-selected` and `ab-color-background-accent-subtle`: lowest 4.80 light, 7.22 dark (needs 4.5:1).

color-text-disabled.$description: An unavailable control (exempt from contrast); pair with `aria-disabled` and an explanation.

color-text-on-accent.$description: Content on `ab-color-background-accent-bold` (rest, hovered, pressed): lowest 9.93 light, 8.39 dark.

color-text-on-danger.$description: Content on `ab-color-background-danger-bold` (rest, hovered, pressed): lowest 5.76 light, 6.12 dark.

color-icon-default.$description: Primary glyphs, on `ab-color-surface-default`, `-raised`, `-nested`, `ab-color-background-selected` and `ab-color-background-accent-subtle`: lowest 14.75 light, 13.98 dark (needs 3:1).

color-icon-subtle.$description: Secondary glyphs, on `ab-color-surface-default`, `-raised`, `-nested`, `ab-color-background-selected` and `ab-color-background-accent-subtle`: lowest 6.14 light, 6.53 dark (needs 3:1).

color-icon-subtlest.$description: Lowest-contrast glyphs that still passes AA (helper text, hints), on `ab-color-surface-default`, `-raised`, `-nested`, `ab-color-background-selected` and `ab-color-background-accent-subtle`: lowest 4.56 light, 4.58 dark (needs 3:1).

color-icon-accent.$description: Accent glyphs, on `ab-color-surface-default`, `-raised`, `-nested`, `ab-color-background-selected` and `ab-color-background-accent-subtle`: lowest 11.16 light, 13.23 dark (needs 3:1).

color-icon-selected.$description: The current item in a set, on `ab-color-surface-default`, `-raised`, `-nested`, `ab-color-background-selected` and `ab-color-background-accent-subtle`: lowest 11.16 light, 13.23 dark (needs 3:1).

color-icon-success.$description: Success state, on `ab-color-surface-default`, `-raised`, `-nested`, `ab-color-background-selected` and `ab-color-background-accent-subtle`: lowest 6.44 light, 9.52 dark (needs 3:1).

color-icon-warning.$description: Warning state, on `ab-color-surface-default`, `-raised`, `-nested`, `ab-color-background-selected` and `ab-color-background-accent-subtle`: lowest 3.05 light, 9.70 dark (needs 3:1).

color-icon-danger.$description: Danger state and errors, on `ab-color-surface-default`, `-raised`, `-nested`, `ab-color-background-selected` and `ab-color-background-accent-subtle`: lowest 4.80 light, 7.22 dark (needs 3:1).

color-icon-disabled.$description: An unavailable control (exempt from contrast); pair with `aria-disabled` and an explanation.

color-icon-on-accent.$description: Content on `ab-color-background-accent-bold` (rest, hovered, pressed): lowest 9.93 light, 8.39 dark.

color-border-subtle.$description: Decorative hairline between rows and sections (1.29 light, 1.41 dark on the page, below 3:1 by rule): never the only boundary of a control. Steps up to `ab-color-border-default` under increased contrast.

color-border-default.$description: Control edges that must be seen, on `ab-color-surface-default`, `-raised`, `-nested`, `ab-color-background-selected` and `ab-color-background-accent-subtle`: lowest 3.06 light, 3.06 dark (needs 3:1).

color-border-default-hovered.$description: Hovered control edge, on `ab-color-surface-default`, `-raised`, `-nested`, `ab-color-background-selected` and `ab-color-background-accent-subtle`: lowest 4.56 light, 4.58 dark (needs 3:1).

color-border-accent.$description: Accent edge, on `ab-color-surface-default`, `-raised`, `-nested`, `ab-color-background-selected` and `ab-color-background-accent-subtle`: lowest 11.16 light, 13.23 dark (needs 3:1).

color-border-focused.$description: The 2px focus ring (`ab-focus-ring-width`, offset `ab-focus-ring-offset`) on every interactive element, on `ab-color-surface-default`, `-raised`, `-nested`, `ab-color-background-selected` and `ab-color-background-accent-subtle`: lowest 11.16 light, 13.23 dark (needs 3:1).

color-border-selected.$description: Edge of the current item in a set, on `ab-color-surface-default`, `-raised`, `-nested`, `ab-color-background-selected` and `ab-color-background-accent-subtle`: lowest 11.16 light, 13.23 dark (needs 3:1).

color-border-success.$description: Success edge, on `ab-color-surface-default`, `-raised`, `-nested`, `ab-color-background-selected` and `ab-color-background-accent-subtle`: lowest 6.44 light, 9.52 dark (needs 3:1).

color-border-warning.$description: Warning edge, on `ab-color-surface-default`, `-raised`, `-nested`, `ab-color-background-selected` and `ab-color-background-accent-subtle`: lowest 3.05 light, 9.70 dark (needs 3:1).

color-border-danger.$description: Danger edge (invalid fields), on `ab-color-surface-default`, `-raised`, `-nested`, `ab-color-background-selected` and `ab-color-background-accent-subtle`: lowest 4.80 light, 7.22 dark (needs 3:1).

color-border-disabled.$description: Edge of an unavailable control (exempt from contrast).

color-material-thin.$description: Translucent thin fill for overlay chrome (menus, the command palette), always with `ab-material-blur-thin`; never for in-flow content or long text. Solid overlay surface under reduced transparency.

color-material-regular.$description: Translucent regular fill for overlay chrome (menus, the command palette), always with `ab-material-blur-regular`; never for in-flow content or long text. Solid overlay surface under reduced transparency.

color-material-thick.$description: Translucent thick fill for overlay chrome (menus, the command palette), always with `ab-material-blur-thick`; never for in-flow content or long text. Solid overlay surface under reduced transparency.

color-shadow-ring.$description: Hairline ring colour inside `ab-elevation-*`; separates an overlay on any background. Moss-tinted in light, deep night in dark.

color-shadow-ambient.$description: Contact-shadow colour inside `ab-elevation-*`. Moss-tinted in light, deep night in dark.

color-shadow-key.$description: Key-shadow colour inside `ab-elevation-overlay` and `ab-elevation-toast`. Moss-tinted in light, deep night in dark.

color-shadow-deep.$description: Key-shadow colour inside `ab-elevation-modal`. Moss-tinted in light, deep night in dark.

opacity-subtle.$description: A faint trace of the current colour, such as a keycap border on a coloured host or a pulse's low point.

opacity-bold.$description: A slightly softened current colour, such as keycap text on a coloured host.

type-heading-lg.$description: Serif title. Fluid 29→33px between 360px and 1280px viewports (`ab-font-size-29-33`); the size shown is the 1280px end. In CSS: `font: var(--ab-type-heading-lg)` plus `letter-spacing: var(--ab-type-heading-lg-letter-spacing)`.

type-heading-md.$description: Serif title. Fluid 24→26px between 360px and 1280px viewports (`ab-font-size-24-26`); the size shown is the 1280px end. In CSS: `font: var(--ab-type-heading-md)` plus `letter-spacing: var(--ab-type-heading-md-letter-spacing)`.

type-heading-sm.$description: Serif title. Fluid 19→21px between 360px and 1280px viewports (`ab-font-size-19-21`); the size shown is the 1280px end. In CSS: `font: var(--ab-type-heading-sm)` plus `letter-spacing: var(--ab-type-heading-sm-letter-spacing)`.

type-heading-xs.$description: Serif title. In CSS: `font: var(--ab-type-heading-xs)` plus `letter-spacing: var(--ab-type-heading-xs-letter-spacing)`.

type-display-md.$description: Serif statement. Fluid 24→26px between 360px and 1280px viewports (`ab-font-size-24-26`); the size shown is the 1280px end. In CSS: `font: var(--ab-type-display-md)` plus `letter-spacing: var(--ab-type-display-md-letter-spacing)`.

type-body-lg.$description: Sans reading text. Fluid 19→21px between 360px and 1280px viewports (`ab-font-size-19-21`); the size shown is the 1280px end. In CSS: `font: var(--ab-type-body-lg)` plus `letter-spacing: var(--ab-type-body-lg-letter-spacing)`.

type-body-md.$description: Sans reading text. In CSS: `font: var(--ab-type-body-md)` plus `letter-spacing: var(--ab-type-body-md-letter-spacing)`.

type-body-sm.$description: Sans reading text. In CSS: `font: var(--ab-type-body-sm)` plus `letter-spacing: var(--ab-type-body-sm-letter-spacing)`.

type-body-xs.$description: Sans reading text. In CSS: `font: var(--ab-type-body-xs)` plus `letter-spacing: var(--ab-type-body-xs-letter-spacing)`.

type-label-lg.$description: Sans control text. In CSS: `font: var(--ab-type-label-lg)` plus `letter-spacing: var(--ab-type-label-lg-letter-spacing)`.

type-label-sm.$description: Dense UI text: menus, tabs, inputs, buttons. In CSS: `font: var(--ab-type-label-sm)` plus `letter-spacing: var(--ab-type-label-sm-letter-spacing)`.

type-kbd-sm.$description: Shortcut hints (Kbd). Set with tabular figures. In CSS: `font: var(--ab-type-kbd-sm)` plus `letter-spacing: var(--ab-type-kbd-sm-letter-spacing)`.

type-label-md.$description: Sans control text. In CSS: `font: var(--ab-type-label-md)` plus `letter-spacing: var(--ab-type-label-md-letter-spacing)`.

type-data-md.$description: Tabular figures. Set with tabular figures. In CSS: `font: var(--ab-type-data-md)` plus `letter-spacing: var(--ab-type-data-md-letter-spacing)`.

type-data-sm.$description: Tabular figures. Set with tabular figures. In CSS: `font: var(--ab-type-data-sm)` plus `letter-spacing: var(--ab-type-data-sm-letter-spacing)`.

type-code-md.$description: Monospace code. In CSS: `font: var(--ab-type-code-md)` plus `letter-spacing: var(--ab-type-code-md-letter-spacing)`.

type-overline-sm.$description: Uppercase group label. Set with tabular figures and uppercase. In CSS: `font: var(--ab-type-overline-sm)` plus `letter-spacing: var(--ab-type-overline-sm-letter-spacing)`.
